findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: describe_business, submit_request, inspect_offer, counter_offer · Private data: submit_request, request_status, inspect_offer, release_payment, retrieve_deliverable, state_purchasing_requirements, report_vendor_status, inspect_delivery, answer_remedy · Public sink: describe_business, submit_request, submit_purchase_order · Destructive: submit_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: describe_business, submit_request, inspect_offer, counter_offer · Private data: submit_request, request_status, inspect_offer, release_payment, retrieve_deliverable, state_purchasing_requirements, report_vendor_status, inspect_delivery, answer_remedy · Public sink: describe_business, submit_request, submit_purchase_order · Destructive: submit_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
